effective_top_p.policy: top_p omitted from all requests (provider/OpenRouter default applies)

openai/gpt-5.6-terra.basis: OpenAI GPT-5.x REASONING line — accepts NEITHER top_p NOR temperature on any endpoint (verified live 2026-07-31: all endpoints decline both). Effective top_p 1.0, UNCONFIGURABLE; the configured advisor temperature 0.7 does NOT apply to this model (runs at model default) — documented sampling-coverage exception, same class as the pilot's gpt-5-nano.

meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct.basis: Patient simulator, kept off the advisor slate by design (the simulator must not be one of the five advisor models under test). Accepts top_p on every served endpoint -> OpenRouter injects its documented default top_p=1.0 for the omitted parameter before forwarding upstream. The provider list is the OBSERVED routing set (12 endpoints, re-verified live 2026-08-05, top_p accepted unanimously); the run pins routing to DeepInfra/Novita for price stability, which is recorded separately in config/models.yaml provider_pins.

meta-llama/llama-4-maverick.basis: Accepts top_p on every served endpoint → OpenRouter injects its documented default top_p=1.0 for the omitted parameter before forwarding upstream.

google/gemini-3.6-flash.basis: SPLIT endpoints (verified live 2026-07-31): Google AI Studio endpoints accept top_p/temperature; Google Vertex endpoints do not. TUP PINS routing to Google AI Studio (config/models.yaml provider_pins + allow_fallbacks:false), so on the pinned route OpenRouter injects its documented default top_p=1.0 for the omitted parameter and the configured temperatures apply. The unanimity check is replaced by the pin check for this entry.
google/gemini-3.6-flash.native_default_note: Gemini native topP ~0.95 would apply on an unpinned Vertex route (which rejects the param) — the AI-Studio pin is what keeps the effective value at the injected 1.0.
